shared_elements: carved stone surface in low/shallow relief
horizontal band or register dividing the composition
row of repeated motifs running across the upper part
figures shown in profile with limbs/arms rendered flat against the surface
raised outlined forms against a flat cut-back ground
weathered pale stone with surface damage
justification: Both are shallow relief on weathered pale stone and both organise their imagery with a horizontal band of repeated units across the top above a larger figural zone, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a polished, naturalistic procession of overlapping human figures with fine detail of hair and drapery on a flat wall surface, while B is a coarse, schematic array of isolated animal and abstract forms distributed over a free-standing block with no shared subject matter or carving hand.
